description: Start a local twin of an API. `source` is a built-in pack (see packs_list), any API name (looked up in the public APIs.guru directory), a path to an OpenAPI/Swagger or twin definition file, or a URL to one. Or pass `definition` (a twin definition you wrote, e.g. after twin_from_docs). Returns the base URL to point the app at, the dashboard, the webhook secret and config snippets.

name.description: Name for this twin (default: its id)

persist.description: Keep this twin's objects between restarts (saved under ~/.mockanything/state)

webhooks.description: Localhost URLs to deliver webhooks to

name: twin_start
